notes.title: Final Patch | Localization
notes.notes:
The time has come for us to move on from Critter Isle. This will be the last update for the game. We appreciate everyone who played the playtest and the base game, and everyone who gave their feedback.

This update pushes localization support to allow you to play the game in your language. It has been set up to allow for community support in translating to other languages. Instructions to submit an official translation, or to import a translation pack are below.

[b][u]TRANSLATING YOUR GAME[/u][/b]
If you want to submit an official translation, open the master spreadsheet(linked below) and copy the English column to your own spreadsheet. Fill out the translations then send your translations to our email: [b]pixelfroggames@gmail.com[/b]. We will review it and add it to the master sheet for anyone to use.

If you want to use a translation pack, open the master spreadsheet(linked below) and copy the column for the language of your choice to your own spreadsheet. Export your spreadsheet as a [b].tsv[/b] file. Rename this exported file to "CritterIsleLanguage" followed by the language identifier(i.e. CritterIsleLanguage_PTBR.tsv). Drag and drop this file into the folder with your executable. The game should load the translations automatically. [b]NOTE:[/b] Translated games may encounter formatting issues like text runoff.

If you are having trouble with any of this, visit the Pixel Frog Discord for support.

[b]Master Spreadsheet:[/b] https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1TKGg7l9wRelcEEsNpcxqha0k-BFJWEsZvINZTDzIq5M/edit?usp=sharing
